summary: Group 1 Automotive filed an 8-K on May 19, 2026, announcing the appointment of Daniel McHenry as President and CEO of its UK business, effective immediately, subject to regulatory approval. McHenry, currently CFO, will hold both roles, replacing Mark Raban, who is leaving after two years. No financial terms, premium, or shareholder vote required. The board supports the change, noting talent development. This is a routine executive succession, not a contested or abrupt departure. What to watch: regulatory approval timeline and McHenry's dual-role performance.
